verdict.rationale: Quo ships an AI agent (Sona), so letting it plug in external MCP servers and use their tools is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Quo's own public MCP server and its connectors for Claude and ChatGPT. That is the server role, where other agents call Quo, and it does not count toward Quo consuming third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows Quo or Sona acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
